newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil panel to begin mulling telcom privatization.
newsitem.headline: Brazil panel to begin mulling telcom privatization.

text.p: A bill regulating the privatization of Brazil's telecommunications industry was due to begin committee-level deliberations later on Tuesday, an official said.
The special committee was due to meet for a first time at 1800 local/2000 GMT to elect its president, vice-president and a deputy appointed to draw up a draft version of the bill, the official said.
In an attempt to speed up passage of the bill through the Chamber of Deputies, the special committee was created to incorporate the functions of three separate lower house committees.

The government hopes to approve its General Telecommunications Law by April to begin privatizing the federally owned Telebras system later this year. Analysts say that timetable is likely to be delayed.
